symptom: `describe user role` omits `CheckSecurity` when it is false; create role with CheckSecurity: false, describe, drop, replay -> `show user roles` says Check Security: Yes. Silent security change on replay.
cause: formatUserRoleMDL followed 'leave out a property at Mendix's default (R12)' but printed CheckSecurity only when true, the inverse of the default: Security$UserRole.CheckSecurity defaults to true (modelsdk/canon/studiopro_property_defaults.json), and genSec.NewUserRole writes it so. `create or modify` keeps an unstated stored value too, so even replay onto an existing role kept true.
insight: An 'omit at default' describer is only correct if the omitted value equals what the writer gives a new element; check the default in studiopro_property_defaults.json, not Go's zero value. The executor mock hid it: userRoleCtx's AddUserRole built roles with Go's zero CheckSecurity (false), matching the describer's wrong assumption, so the #707 round-trip test was green. A mock write method must mirror the real writer's defaults or the round trip proves nothing. For a security flag prefer always-explicit: create-or-modify keeps unstated values, so omission is never safe on replay onto an existing role.
